about_the_game:
“Unbreachable” is a DARK FANTASY PvP strategy game. Build your own castle, optimize your layout and fight in online battles against the builds of other players.

BUILD

You start with an empty piece of land, where you can construct your first castle buildings. Place training grounds and use synergies with other buildings to train your army.

Optimize to get the maximum out of your buildings' abilities and use fusions to create stronger variants of buildings and units.

PVP BATTLES

Once you have set up a castle and army, attack another players castle with your troops and watch them laying siege on your opponent in an autobattle. But beware, the enemy's army will forego with a counter attack and test the defenses of your castle.

CONQUER

If you are successful you will become higher in rank and meet stronger opponents on your next siege campaign.

DARK FANTASY

“Unbreachable” is set in a dark fantasy world. Experience unknown nostalgia and retro vibes while building a mighty fortress and setting up a powerful army to defend it against foes. Enjoy the custom dungeon synth soundtrack to immerse yourself even deeper into the world of “UNBREACHABLE”.

name: Unbreachable
short_description: UNBREACHABLE is a turn-based PvP strategy game with auto-battler mechanics. Build your own fortress, use synergies and watch it battle against other players to become the ruler of all the lands!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian
